# NeuraTrade Pull Request Template

**PR Type**
*Please select one:*
* New Feature
* Bug Fix
* Documentation Update
* Performance Improvement
* Other (please specify)

**Description of Changes**
*Please describe the changes made, including:*
* Overview of the changes
* Rationale behind the changes
* Any new dependencies or libraries introduced

**Related Issues**
*List related issues (if any):*
* Issue # (if fixing a bug)
* Issue # (if related to a feature request)

**Checklist**
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation (if necessary)
- [ ] I have tested my changes with the NeuraTrade testing framework (if applicable)
